description: 引离b7兵——后牺牲引兵，象a6绝杀
explanation_en: A queen sacrifice deflects the b7-pawn, allowing the bishop to deliver mate on a6.

intro.popup: 💡 白方如何牺牲后引离b7兵，让象走a6绝杀？
intro.popup_en: 💡 How can White sacrifice the queen to deflect the b7-pawn and deliver mate with the bishop on a6?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Qxc6+！后牺牲引离b7兵——兵被迫bxc6，打通b7格，Ba6绝杀黑王c8！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Qxc6+! sacrifices the queen to deflect the b7-pawn. After ...bxc6, the b7-square is clear and Ba6# mates the king on c8.

moves.popup: 白后Qxc6+！后牺牲！引离b7兵——b7兵必须来吃后，同时打开b7格。
moves.popup_en: Qxc6+! White sacrifices the queen to deflect the b7-pawn, which must capture and vacate b7.

moves.popup: 黑兵bxc6！引离成功——b7格打开，象可以到a6了！
moves.popup_en: ...bxc6! The deflection succeeds: b7 is clear, so the bishop can move to a6.

moves.popup: 白象Ba6# 绝杀！象覆盖b7格，Bg3象封c8方向，黑王c8无处可逃！
moves.popup_en: Ba6#! The bishop controls b7, while the bishop on g3 covers the route from c8. The black king has no escape.
